categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the energy IoT equipment sector, focusing on the research, production, sales, and services of smart meters (electricity and water), intelligent power terminals and systems, smart flow meters, smart power distribution products, and IoT sensors and accessories. The company also provides comprehensive energy solutions integrating IoT terminals with big data and cloud computing for public energy sectors including water, electricity, gas, and heat.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded AI, IoT, big data, cloud computing, and communication technologies such as high-speed power line carrier, wired and wireless 4G/NB for smart meter functionality. It has developed intelligent measurement and acquisition systems with MCU integration, modular design, and advanced sensing technologies. Manufacturing is supported by an intelligent MES system integrated with ERP, CRM, PLM, RMS, WMS, and PVS, enabling high automation and quality control, recognized as an advanced smart factory.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Power Grid, as well as industrial, commercial, residential users, and public institutions like hospitals and schools. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including Germany, Czech Republic, and Belt and Road countries, focusing on energy utilities and smart city infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant presence in the Yangtze River Delta region. It also has overseas subsidiaries and markets in Europe (Germany, Czech Republic) and other Belt and Road countries. Its international operations include a wholly-owned subsidiary in the Czech Republic and a Hong Kong-based investment company.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy IoT supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of smart metering devices and IoT terminals, as well as providing integrated energy management solutions and services to utilities and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in embedded AI for smart energy measurement, virtual power plant energy control systems, and integration of IoT with big data and cloud computing. It aims to innovate in public energy metering, AMI systems, smart flow measurement, electric vehicle charging, power quality management, and electrical safety monitoring. The strategic focus includes expanding energy IoT platforms and advancing digital, green, and low-carbon energy solutions aligned with national policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart meters, IoT devices, and related systems. The company also earns income from providing energy monitoring, operation, maintenance, and integrated energy-saving services. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to other revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-tech enterprise in China's energy metering and IoT equipment industry, recognized for strong technical innovation and manufacturing capabilities. It competes with domestic and international smart meter and energy IoT solution providers, leveraging its advanced R&D, smart manufacturing, and comprehensive service offerings to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.03 billion, a 14.54% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 664.7 million, up 9.45%. Total assets reached RMB 4.81 billion, growing 9.11%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by increased production and sales volumes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology differentiates itself through advanced embedded AI and IoT integration in smart metering, enabling multifunctional, modular, and intelligent energy measurement devices. Its products support comprehensive energy management, demand response, and smart grid interoperability. The company’s intelligent manufacturing system ensures high quality and efficiency, while its strong technical marketing and after-sales service teams enhance customer value and market responsiveness.
